Amp Type state i is cab_model i, the d.enum4 modern binds to ampSim `cabModel`.
What the cabinet changes, for the amp switch to add.
Amp Sw puts the cabinet after the curve, the d.enum2 modern binds to ampSim `cab`.

effects.modulation.autoWah's envelope follower: the rectified peak of the input through one pole, 8 ms rising and 120 ms falling (AutoWahConfig). The candidate reads each side apart, so the follower takes the mean of the two where autoWah takes their larger.

effects.modulation.autoWah's envelope follower: the rectified peak of the input through one pole, 8 ms rising and 120 ms falling (AutoWahConfig). The candidate reads each side apart, so the follower takes the mean of the two where autoWah takes their larger.
The follower's level back from decibels to a multiplier (10^(dB/20), exact where the points interpolate in the log), floored 120 dB down.
Sens scales the envelope, the law modern binds to autoWah `sensitivity`.
autoWah opens its corner by the scaled envelope across its whole sweep; the candidate's sweep axis is the Manual byte's 0..127, so a full envelope moves the position 127.
